No, there is **no strong scientific evidence** that over-the-counter anti-gray hair pills can prevent or reverse gray hair.[[1]](https://www.verywellhealth.com/do-supplements-for-gray-hair-work-8415859)[[2]](https://www.today.com/health/skin-beauty/gray-hair-reversal-serums-rcna97961)

### What You Should Know About Anti-Gray Pills

- **Lack of Clinical Proof:** Most commercial supplements—which typically contain vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants—have not been validated by large, double-blind, placebo-controlled human trials to restore or stop hair pigment.[[1]](https://www.today.com/health/skin-beauty/gray-hair-reversal-serums-rcna97961)[[2]](https://www.verywellhealth.com/do-supplements-for-gray-hair-work-8415859)
- **Regulation Gaps:** Dietary supplements do not require Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval for effectiveness before hitting store shelves.[[1]](https://www.today.com/video/do-anti-gray-hair-products-really-work-189798469842)
- **General Hair Health:** While ingredients like B vitamins, copper, or zinc may support overall hair and scalp health, they will not turn gray hair back to its natural color once the hair follicle has stopped producing melanin.[[1]](https://www.everydayhealth.com/nutrients/vitamins/fighting-gray-hair-with-vitamins/)[[2]](https://www.verywellhealth.com/do-supplements-for-gray-hair-work-8415859)

### When Supplements Might Actually Help

- **Nutritional Deficiencies:** If your graying is premature and tied to a diagnosed deficiency—such as a lack of **vitamin B12**, **copper** , or **iron** —correcting that deficiency with medical guidance can sometimes support normal pigmentation.[[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12182098/)[[2]](https://www.everydayhealth.com/nutrients/vitamins/fighting-gray-hair-with-vitamins/)
- **Next Steps:** It is safest to consult a primary care doctor or a dermatologist for blood tests to check for underlying nutritional gaps or thyroid issues rather than self-treating with specialized anti-gray blends.[[1]](https://www.verywellhealth.com/do-supplements-for-gray-hair-work-8415859)[[2]](https://www.everydayhealth.com/nutrients/vitamins/fighting-gray-hair-with-vitamins/)
